{{Quote|I was among a caravan of Ryn ships that had left the Corporate Sector for the Lesser Plooriod Cluster when the Yuuzhan Vong pushed into the Ottega system and destroyed Ithor.|[[Droma]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="HT">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>}}
The '''Ottega system''',<ref name="TSWS" /><ref name="TEA" /> also called the '''Ottegan system''',<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|430|Ottega system}}</ref> the '''Ithor system''',<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref><ref name="KOTOR49">[[Knights of the Old Republic 49|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 49]]</ref> or the '''Ithorian system''',<ref name="DA">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref><ref name="Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref><ref name="YDR" /> was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Lesser Plooriod Cluster/Legends|Lesser Plooriod Cluster]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Ottega sector/Legends|Ottega sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It centered around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Ottega (star)|Ottega]], and its orbitals included [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]], and two [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]].<ref name="TEA" />

The unusually dense outer portions of the Ottega system consisted of 69 planets and 565 moons.<ref name="TEA" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Imperial forces loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] were tasked with the destruction of Imperial traitors who had aligned themselves with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] while under the command of the treacherous Admiral [[Harkov]]. Having dealt with Harkov himself, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] led a task force into the Ottega system that eventually saw the complete destruction of Harkov's traitor forces and the Rebels who had attempted to intervene. It was during this campaign that [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] launched his coup d'etat against [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in his attempt to usurp control of the Empire.
